segments.text: proposition 1 THoſe, before God, are counted the dooers of the lawe, which hauing faith in Chriſt, doo earneſtlie exerciſe themſelues in the obedience of his commandements.

proposition 2 In that ſentence of
Daniel: Thou ſhalt redeeme thy ſinnes with almes, he meaneth, the puniſhment and paine which is due for ſinnes.

proposition 3 They which by their owne iudgement, not by the word and lawe of God, will determine of the goodneſſe and naughtineſſe of humane actions, thoſe eate the fruit of the trée of good and euill, forbidden to our firſt parents.
